headline: PM Tarique Rahman meets UN Special Envoy Julie Bishop on Rohingya crisis at UNGA
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman discussed sustainable solutions for the Rohingya crisis and sought international cooperation for their dignified repatriation during his meeting with UN Special Envoy Julie Bishop in New York.
details: Bangladesh's Prime Minister Tarique Rahman met with UN Secretary-General's Special Envoy on Myanmar, Julie Bishop, in New York. The meeting took place on Tuesday at the Hyatt Grand Central Hotel during the 81st UN General Assembly.

Discussions focused on finding a sustainable solution to the Rohingya crisis and the international community's effective role in resolving the issue. Prime Minister Rahman sought international cooperation to ensure the dignified repatriation of the Rohingyas.
caption:
Bangladesh's Prime Minister Tarique Rahman met UN Special Envoy Julie Bishop in New York to address the ongoing Rohingya crisis.

headline_marked: [[Deep depression forms in Bay of Bengal]], ports on alert with warning signal No. 3
headline: Deep depression forms in Bay of Bengal, ports on alert with warning signal No. 3
summary: A low-pressure system has intensified into a deep depression over the west-central and adjoining northwest Bay. Four major sea ports in Bangladesh have been asked to hoist local warning signal No. 3.
details: A low-pressure system over the Bay of Bengal has moved northwest and intensified into a deep depression. This system is currently centered over the west-central Bay and adjoining northwest Bay.
According to meteorologist Khandaker Hafizur Rahman, it is not expected to develop into a cyclone for now. However, its influence may bring rain to the southern and southwestern parts of Bangladesh.

At 9 PM, the deep depression was located 875km southwest of Chattogram, 850km southwest of Cox’s Bazar, 695km southwest of Mongla, and 720km southwest of Payra. It is moving further west and northwest.
The depression is expected to cross India’s north Andhra Pradesh-south Odisha coast by Wednesday midnight. Gusty winds are likely to affect sea ports, the north Bay, and adjoining coastal areas.

Winds within 48km of its center are reaching 50kmph, with gusts up to 60kmph. Due to rough seas near the center, Chattogram, Cox’s Bazar, Mongla, and Payra ports have been asked to hoist local warning signal No. 3.
Fishing boats and trawlers operating in the north Bay have been advised to remain close to the coast. They should proceed with caution until further notice from the meteorological department.
